mapper.select: select user_id, descriptor from sys_user_face where user_id > #{afterUserId} and descriptor not like 'gcm:%' order by user_id limit 100
select f.user_id from sys_user_face f join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' where f.user_id > #{afterUserId} order by f.user_id limit 100
select user_id, descriptor, algorithm, samples, status, create_time, update_time from sys_user_face where user_id = #{userId}
select user_id from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' for update

select exists ( select 1 from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from sys_user_face_policy p where p.user_id = u.user_id and p.enabled = 0 ) )

select f.user_id is not null as enrolled, coalesce(p.enabled, 1) as enabled, coalesce(f.update_time, f.create_time) as updated_at from sys_user u left join sys_user_face f on f.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_user_face_policy p on p.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0'
